chunks: He said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh al-Qummi, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to me, from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Asim ibn Humaid al-Hannat, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Hanash ibn al-Mu'tamir, who said:

I entered upon the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, while he was in al-Rahbah, reclining. So I said: "Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, and the mercy of God and His blessings. How are you this morning?"

He raised his head, returned the greeting and said: "I have entered this morning loving those who love us, and patient against the hatred of those who hate us. Indeed, the one who loves us awaits repose and deliverance every day and night, while the one who hates us has built a structure and laid its foundation on the edge of a crumbling bank, and his structure has collapsed and tumbled down with him into the fire of Hell."

O Abu al-Mu'tamir, indeed the one who loves us cannot hate us, and the one who hates us cannot love us. Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has shaped the hearts of His servants with love for us and has forsaken those who hate us. So the one who loves us shall never be able to hate us, and the one who hates us shall never be able to love us, and love for us and love for our enemy shall never be combined in one heart.
Allah has not assigned to any man two hearts in his chest.
loving one people with this heart and loving their enemies with the other.

key_terms.جبل قلوب العباد: Shaped the hearts of the servants -- innate disposition (fitra)
key_terms.مبغضنا: One who hates us -- enemies of the Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.محبنا: One who loves us (the Ahlul Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about loving the Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Hanash ibn al-Mu'tamir visits Imam Ali (AS) at al-Rahbah courtyard in Kufa and asks about his morning. The Imam responds with a profound teaching on the spiritual nature of love for Ahlul Bayt, explaining that God created human hearts with an innate inclination toward them and quoting Quran 33:4 to illustrate that opposing loves cannot coexist in one heart.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
